feature: Filter chassis — one control on four routes
note:
Four routes the brief says carry the same filter control. `view` names each route's OWN view file, never a wrapper it mounts. Steps are plain `goto`s because every surface here is a page.

NO `shares` BLOCK YET, deliberately. All four routes already render `FilterChassis` — /decks directly, /commanders and /discover through the shared `FilterRack`, /collection through `FilterBar` — and composing the chassis behind a route-level assembler is the design working, not a defect, because the chassis takes its controls as props. Pointing `shares.module` at the chassis therefore failed three routes for doing the right thing.

What is genuinely duplicated is the phone sheet: `DeckFilterSheet`, the rack's `FilterSheet` and `CollectionFilterSheet` are three implementations of one job, and the handoff (STATES §49, §157, §177-180) describes one sheet pattern whose CONTENTS vary by route. The ruling is one sheet component taking its dimensions as props. When it lands, add `shares` here pointing at it — direct import is the right invariant for a leaf component in a way it never was for the chassis.
